name: cable-crunch.html
instructions:
1. Attach a rope handle to the high pulley of a cable machine.
2. Kneel in front of the machine and hold the rope with both hands, bringing it around your head.
3. Keep your knees slightly bent and your hips stationary. This is the starting position.
4. Engage your core and pull the rope down by crunching your torso forward.
5. Continue to pull the rope towards your knees, focusing on contracting your abs. Keep your elbows fixed.
6. Release the tension and slowly return to the starting position. This is one rep.
7. Perform the desired number of reps while maintaining control and good form.
